matter_background.original: Saman who is a Notary having Notary License to practise in the Judicial Zone of Colombo is employed as a legal officer at a Real estate company in Colombo. Saman's employer instructs him to execute a Deed of Transfer on urgent basis.
matter_background.normalized: Saman who is a Notary having Notary License to practise in the Judicial Zone of Colombo is employed as a legal officer at a Real estate company in Colombo. Saman's employer instructs him to execute a Deed of Transfer on urgent basis.

questions.question_original: Can Saman execute the said Deed without checking the title at the land registry? Explain with the provisions in Notaries Ordinance.
